matches.rationale: Finding 2 identifies exactly the mechanism described in GT: Lemma 3.1's proof treats the shortest-path selection as fixed (i.e., assumes the path/topology is known/public) and applies Lemma 2.4 to a sum of Laplace variables, when in fact the path is chosen adaptively based on the noisy graph, invalidating the independence assumption Lemma 2.4 requires — the same 'Lemma 2.4 misapplied under false public-topology assumption' issue named in GT.
